title: Detailed slice of pizza
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow/crust base under slice -->
  <polygon points="50,8 18,88 82,88" fill="#6b2d0a"/>

  <!-- pizza slice dough/crust -->
  <polygon points="50,12 22,84 78,84" fill="#e8a33d"/>

  <!-- crust edge along the wide end -->
  <polygon points="20,82 80,82 78,90 22,90" fill="#c97a1e"/>
  <polygon points="22,84 78,84 77,88 23,88" fill="#e8a33d"/>
  <!-- crust highlight -->
  <polygon points="24,85 76,85 75,87 25,87" fill="#f2be6a"/>

  <!-- sauce layer -->
  <polygon points="50,20 26,78 74,78" fill="#c6281a"/>

  <!-- melted cheese with drips -->
  <polygon points="50,24 28,76 72,76" fill="#f5c542"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="55" r="1.6" fill="#e0a820"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="48" r="1.4" fill="#e0a820"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="68" r="1.2" fill="#e0a820"/>
  <!-- cheese highlight blobs -->
  <ellipse cx="44" cy="40" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#ffe27a" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="60" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ffe27a" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- pepperoni slices -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="36" r="5" fill="#b81f1f"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="36" r="3.6" fill="#d93a2b"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="36" r="1.2" fill="#a01414"/>

  <circle cx="58" cy="52" r="5.2" fill="#b81f1f"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="52" r="3.8" fill="#d93a2b"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="52" r="1.3" fill="#a01414"/>

  <circle cx="40" cy="68" r="4.6" fill="#b81f1f"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="68" r="3.3" fill="#d93a2b"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="68" r="1.1" fill="#a01414"/>

  <!-- yellow pepper pieces -->
  <polygon points="65,38 69,35 67,41" fill="#f7d23a"/>
  <polygon points="35,52 38,49 37,55" fill="#f7d23a"/>

  <!-- spinach leaves -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="72" rx="3" ry="1.6" transform="rotate(-30 52 72)" fill="#3a8c2a"/>
  <ellipse cx="48" cy="28" rx="2.6" ry="1.4" transform="rotate(20 48 28)" fill="#3a8c2a"/>

  <!-- tiny herb specks -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="46" r="0.8" fill="#2e7d22"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="66" r="0.7" fill="#2e7d22"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="60" r="0.8" fill="#2e7d22"/>

  <!-- grease sheen highlights on cheese -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="2" ry="1" fill="#fff3b0" opacity="0.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="58" rx="1.8" ry="0.9" fill="#fff3b0" opacity="0.4"/>
</svg>
